# **Lucky Pocket**

**Lucky Pocket** is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly Minecraft mod that introduces useful pocket talismans to enhance your survival experience. No need to clutter your armor slots—simply craft a charm, keep it in your inventory, and enjoy passive buffs!
It’s the perfect addition for players looking for subtle, balanced upgrades without overwhelming the core gameplay.

## Featured Charms
**Cat's Paw**: The ultimate companion for builders and cave explorers. As long as this item is in your main inventory, it grants you slow falling. Say goodbye to accidental deaths while mining!
(More unique lucky charms and trinkets are planned for future updates!)

## **How It Works**
Early-Game Friendly: All charms can be crafted using basic survival resources right on the crafting table.

Passive Mechanics: You don't need to hold the item in your hand. Just leave it anywhere in your inventory slots, and the effect will apply automatically.

## **FAQ**
Q: Do I need extra mod dependencies? A: No, this is a standalone mod. Using Just Enough Items (JEI) is highly recommended to easily check the crafting recipes in-game.

Q: Can I use this in my modpack? A: Absolutely! Feel free to include Lucky Pocket in any Minecraft modpack.
